messages:
sophia: Quick draft attached — would love a read + signoff by EOD. Link: https://drive.redwood/launch-draft-v3 (please comment inline). Main asks: headline, accuracy of benchmarks, legal ok for customer quote, UTM tagging. /cc @marc @devin @arya
marc: Skimmed — headline feels a bit long. Suggested shorter options: “Run LLM inference at production scale” or “Predictable LLM inference for production.”
sophia: noted, thanks. Also thinking a short TL;DR at top + one-paragraph customer blurb. Devin — can you check benchmark phrasing? We call out 30% p50 latency reduction vs baseline but need to confirm measured config.
devin: Confirmed — numbers are from Dedicated (A100 80GB, batch=8). Recommend we cite test harness id: `bench-run-2026-02` and link: https://bench.redwood/reports/bench-run-2026-02
arya: Legal flagged the customer quote — need explicit permission for name/logo. @legal-eagle can you confirm if the email thread from ACME counts as permission to publish the quote?
legal-eagle: We have permission for the text quote but NOT the logo. Need a signed LOA for logo use. ACME is fine with anonymized metrics and an attributed quote (no logo).
sophia: Okay — we'll anonymize the case blurb and remove the logo. Marc, can you add headline A/B variants? Also pushing UTM standard: `?utm_source=launch_email&utm_medium=blog_post&utm_campaign=dedicated_launch_v1`
marc: UTM looks good. For CTAs I want to test `Get started` vs `Request a dedicated trial` as separate buttons. I'll drop both in the doc.
mktg-bot: Reminder: launch prep review added to calendar for tomorrow 10:30 PST — attendees @sophia @marc @devin @ops
sophia: Plan: update headline + TL;DR, swap customer quote to anonymized snippet, add a benchmark callout box (link `bench-run-2026-02`), update UTMs, and push new draft by 3pm. Reviewers please reply in-thread with a quick :thumbsup: once you've checked your sections.
devin: Reviewed bench section and updated a footnote about test harness and median vs p50 wording. :thumbsup:
arya: Will sign off on legal copy once I get the LOA confirmation. :white_check_mark:
marc: Pushed CTA variants and left comments on H1. Also added a short meta description suggestion.
sophia: Thanks all — if I get all thumbs by 5pm, I’ll move this to final review and trigger the publishing checklist tomorrow morning. If legal needs the LOA, I’ll follow up with ACME rep today.
